name: Collage Design Skill
purpose: Procedural mixed-media collage generation with torn paper edges, deckle borders, halftone patterns, and cut masking tape.
capabilities: Procedural torn paper edge generation via SVG feTurbulence
Mixed-media collage composition rules and asset layering
Blueprint grids, adhesive tape, and halftone texture overlays
Headless Chromium SVG to PNG rasterization

compatibility.notes: Tested in Chromium headless. Heavy host CLI dependencies (ImageMagick, Inkscape) are bypassed using browser-native SVG rasterization.

licensing.notes: Apache 2.0 verified upstream (polgarp/collage-design commit 442f6717). External image assets require explicit CC0/public domain attribution.

security.notes: Design guidelines and SVG templates. Script check_deps.sh reviewed; external tool installations are not executed automatically.

approval_evidence: Validated experimental prototype in tests/prototypes/collage/ (collage.svg rendered to 1280x720 PNG in 88.5 KB via headless Chromium). Marked experimental until automated pipeline ingestion is standardized.
